acceptance_signals: A new internal Python tool exists only under scripts/task_start_scope_baseline and has no public package or CLI integration.

Capture binds the baseline to the exact task path, validated task digest, repository-relative paths, comparison base, HEAD, and normalized staged, unstaged, untracked, and committed-since-base identities.
Persisted baseline contains no raw file contents, raw patches, absolute paths, environment values, credentials, process identifiers, or host/user identity.
Baseline creation is exclusive and refuses overwrite, symlink targets, malformed task records, unsafe paths, unstable capture, and missing Git state.
Comparison treats unchanged pre-existing excluded paths as preserved, included post-start changes as allowed, and new or changed excluded or unclassified paths as failures.
Rename and copy endpoints, deletions, index-only changes, worktree-only changes, task-digest drift, HEAD drift, missing baselines, and malformed baselines have deterministic fail-closed behavior.
The tool performs only read-only Git inspection in the real repository and writes only its explicitly selected local baseline file.
Fixture tests cover passing, failing, preserved, rename or copy, staged, unstaged, untracked, malformed, stale, unsafe-path, and unstable-capture cases.
Existing foreground STDIO controller code, predecessor task records, and predecessor evidence in the included scope remain byte-identical.
Documentation clearly states the bootstrap limit: this task cannot use the not-yet-existing baseline to prove its own start state.
STATUS and the dated development log distinguish implemented capability from the later separately admitted controller closeout.
Declared validation passes without claiming the existing cumulative worktree scope check has passed.
No dependency, network, model call, Git transition, commit, push, release, deployment, publication, or host execution is performed.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-3a9e90493c5e43cb8523dc4674997f64 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Build the smallest deterministic internal task-start scope-baseline tool. It will capture privacy-bounded per-path Git-layer identities before a future task writes, persist an immutable local baseline, and compare later state so unchanged pre-existing excluded work is preserved while post-start out-of-scope drift fails closed. This slice enables a separately admitted controller closeout; it does not retroactively validate the controller task or this bootstrap task, and it does not change the public CLI or core package.

items: Capturing after task changes would launder earlier drift, so the tool must label capture timing and cannot validate this bootstrap task retroactively.
A path can have different index and worktree identities; collapsing layers could hide drift.
Rename, copy, deletion, and symlink handling could misattribute an excluded change.
Hash-only records reduce exposure but remain local evidence and must never be exported automatically.
The dirty worktree may change during capture; inconsistent before and after snapshots must abort.
Overwriting a baseline would destroy the audit boundary.
The current cumulative scope checker will still report predecessor excluded paths for this bootstrap task.
Reviewed assumption: The repository is a Git worktree and Python 3.11 is available.
Reviewed assumption: Existing task loading and Git snapshot contracts may be imported read-only without changing src or tests.
Reviewed assumption: Local baseline records live under ignored .agentgov state and remain repository-local.
Reviewed assumption: A later separately admitted task will capture its baseline before any repository write.
Reviewed assumption: Disposable fixture repositories, if needed, do not modify the real repository Git state.
Reviewed unknown: Performance on very large dirty worktrees is not established in this slice.
Reviewed unknown: Public agentgov CLI and development-session integration are deferred.
Reviewed unknown: The exact later controller closeout edits are not yet admitted.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-platform symlink coverage may remain limited by host capabilities.
